purpose: Test binomial and Gaussian-width mechanisms outside graph-star locality for the near-half Boolean PC family.

sources.authors: Sam Buss, Dima Grigoriev, Russell Impagliazzo, Toniann Pitassi
sources.title: Linear Gaps Between Degrees for the Polynomial Calculus Modulo Distinct Primes
sources.read: Definition and Theorem 6 Laurent-relation interface; Theorems 10 and 15 and stated encoding scope.
sources.role: Orientation to the binomial criterion only; no new quantitative lower bound imported.

sources.title: Random CNF's Are Hard for the Polynomial Calculus
sources.version: Computational Complexity 19 (2010), 501-519; journal PDF hosted at IAS
sources.read: Theorem 5.1, Corollaries 5.2-5.4 and the proof on printed pages 515-517; introductory field and encoding conventions.
sources.role: Primary comparison for the mod-2 Gaussian-width architecture. The new proof uses two stages through independent uniform row multipliers for general prime modulus, and supplies its own complete PC transfer.
sources.scope_warning: The journal theorem's mod-2 equations and odd proof characteristic do not themselves give a binary-characteristic lower bound. The new small-subsystem argument uses m<=v+1, without importing the source's m<=n wording or its j/n sampling probability for m rows. The independent random-coefficient proof avoids both parameter issues.

earlier_version: A search result identified a 1999 conference copy at CiteSeerX; opening that mirror failed. It is not relied on. The retrieved later journal version is used only in the exact scope stated above.
redistribution: No third-party full text is committed; the downloaded journal PDF is private scratch. Original proof, checker and complete check output are retained.

checks.engine: GAP exact arithmetic and multivariate polynomials over GF(4)
checks.input: Four specified mod-3 rows on three Boolean variables, every variable occurring in three rows; witness (1,1,1,1) has zero coefficient sum and nonzero charge.
checks.question: Verify the path expectation, balanced-character composition and ordinary degree peaks, not the asymptotic bound.
checks.sizing: Fixed 3^4=81 paths, nine states each, eight transitions each, and 81 local row/charge interpolation identities. No scaling series.
checks.limitation: The concentration bound is vacuous on this tiny system; the asymptotic theorem rests on the proof. Boolean reduction is checked exactly on the complete Boolean cube and justified at the claimed degree by the written domain-reduction certificate.
